name: Casual & Modern Wear
shortDescription: Relaxed-fit jackets, tailored streetwear and everyday separates built with tailoring techniques.
fabricNotes: Cotton twill, brushed cotton, denim, ponte knit and lightweight wool for unstructured pieces.
highlights: Unstructured jackets built for everyday movement
Custom fit for layering pieces and outerwear
Small-batch capsule orders for personal wardrobes
body: Tailoring doesn't have to mean formal. This line applies the same fitting discipline — proper shoulder, clean drape, no pulling at the seams — to the clothes you actually wear most days.
Think unstructured jackets, tailored joggers, fitted overshirts and denim built to your measurements instead of a generic size run.
A favourite with clients building a small, considered wardrobe rather than buying in bulk.
